description: This file defines a SimulationLayer class that provides fake Kubernetes objects and metrics for testing purposes. It includes methods to generate simulated node and pod statuses, metrics, and to execute mock commands within pods.

classes.name: SimulationLayer
classes.description: A simple deterministic simulation class providing fake Kubernetes objects and metrics with configurable failure rate.

methods.name: None __init__(self, enabled: bool, node_count: int, pod_count: int, failure_rate: float)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the simulation with enabled flag, node count, pod count, and failure rate.

methods.name: bool _maybe_fail(self)
methods.description: Internal method probabilistically determining whether to simulate a failure based on the failure rate.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_nodes(self)
methods.description: Generates a list of simulated Kubernetes node objects with ready status.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_pods(self)
methods.description: Generates a list of simulated Kubernetes pod objects with status and restart information.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] top_pods(self)
methods.description: Provides simulated metrics (CPU and Memory) for each pod.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str,str] exec_in_pod(self, namespace: str, pod: str, container: Optional[str], command: List[str])
methods.description: Simulates executing commands inside a pod and returns mock status and output.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, enabled: bool, node_count: int, pod_count: int, failure_rate: float) -> N/
ctags.signature: (self, enabled: bool, node_count: int, pod_count: int, failure_rate: float)

ctags.name: exec_in_pod
ctags.pattern: /^    def exec_in_pod(self, namespace: str, pod: str, container: Optional[str], command: List[str]/
ctags.signature: (self, namespace: str, pod: str, container: Optional[str], command: List[str])
